title: [Bug]: `binding-wasm32-wasi` errors `__napiBindingTarget is reserved by the generated binding loader, but the loaded binding already exports it`
body:
### Reproduction link or steps

Open either one:
- https://vite.new
- https://vitest.new


### What is expected?

No errors should be visible. I think `1.2.8` was working just fine in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest-ecosystem-ci/actions/runs/34831949861/job/103937069120 last week. Now `1.2.9` is erroring https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest-ecosystem-ci/actions/runs/35587970015/job/106295634475.

### What is actually happening?

